summary: Beat the other roller skating girls at the Skate-Off as you dance on wheels!
description: Ready, Set, Skate! Roller skate your heart out at the Skate-o-rama, and dance on wheels, in this supercool girl game! Get ready for the big Skate-Off competition! Design your own roller skating routine, put on your wheels and impress the Skate-Off judges! Dress up in cute new skating outfits, get new makeup and a cool hairstyle at the hair salon and become the best roller skater ever! You’re gonna ROCK this roller skating girl game as you dance on wheels. You’re no newbie to the Skate-o-rama… but you want to get serious and become a roller skating pro! Your new friend at school - Maddie - one of the coolest girls out there and an awesome roller skating dancer, has agreed to train you! So dress up with confidence, put on some makeup, go to the hair salon to rock a new hairstyle. Get your wheels ready - with Maddie’s help and a lot of hard work, you can beat the rest of the roller skating girls, win the Skate-Off competition and impress your crush Jonny while you dance on wheels! Features: ★ You are the star Become the envy of all the roller skater girls at the Skate-o-rama, in your favorite new girl game! Your friend Maddie is going to help you be a roller skating dance star! ★ Practice at the skating rink When you’re ready, dress up in cute roller skating outfits to roller dance on wheels like never before, and climb the ranks of this year’s Skate-Off competition! ★ Dress up time Look like a roller skating dance star on wheels - dress up in an outfit that shows off your inner talent! Will your crush Jonny notice YOU out of all the roller skating girls?! ★ Get your hair and nails done You’re not ready yet - you need to visit the hair salon! A fun makeover with beautiful makeup and a fab new hairstyle will complete your hot roller skating dress up look! Every good girl game needs to include a salon makeover! Shiny nails will help you pop at the Skate-o-rama! Get a manicure and add cool nail stickers! ★ Pampering at the spa After your visit to the hair salon and makeup shop, relax before the big dance on wheels competition at the spa! ★ Always fit for the challenge Oh no - skating injury! Go to the doctor to get treated before the Skate-Off!
